label: Each actual root withholds (WITHHOLD_2) giving each grounded actual concretum at an accessible world
paraphrase: OPEN premise (a), analyst formulation, unattributed: for every actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w and every actual concretum x that n grounds at w, there is a world accessible from w where n exists and does not give x being. #1897's two-way profile extended from the actual contingents to every being the root grounds, including any putatively NECESSARY_2 one; close to the theist-internal free-creation premise. Under (b2), factive giving, a common root, necessary roots and excluded middle it is equivalent to NAR (43651417): the same commitment in the giving register, not additional evidence. 'Withholds' is WITHHOLD_2, accessible per-effect non-giving with the root present (actualRootsWithholdEachGrounded_iff); no choice, control or agency is part of it. The choice-cell premises 0dd78706 and 46a468b2 re-present it in the STIT register (cellsRepresentationIff, #2103).
